title: Black & Decker Coffeemakers Recalled by Applica Consumer Products Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The coffee pot handle can break, causing cuts and burns to the consumer. Units: About 159,000.

title: Strollers Recalled by Kolcraft Due to Fingertip Amputation and Laceration Hazards
summary: A child or consumer's finger can become caught in the opening formed when locking and unlocking the hinge mechanism which is used to adjust the handlebars on the strollers. This presents an amputation and laceration hazard to children and the adults handling the stroller. Units: About 36,000 in the

title: California Innovations Expands Recall of Freezer Gel Packs Due to Ingestion Hazard
summary: If the packs become damaged, they can leak gel that could contain diethylene glycol and ethylene glycol, which can cause illness if ingested in large amounts. Units: About 880,000 (about 248,000 units associated with lunch boxes and 55,000 associated with food carriers were previously recalled in Ja

title: Nautilus Recalls Bowflex Dumbbells Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The weight selector dial on the units can fail, causing weight plates to fall when the dumbbell is lifted from its cradle, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 17,000.

title: West Marine Recalls Folding Deck Chairs Due to Collapse Hazard
summary: The chair cannot support the stated weight capacity. This poses a collapse hazard to consumers. Units: 1,200 units.

title: Evenflo Recalls Convertible High Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The activity tray on the high chair can unexpectedly detach and allow an unrestrained child to fall, posing a risk of injury to the child. Units: About 35,000 in the United States.

title: Children's Lounge Pants and Boxers Recalled by Rigo International Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pants and boxers fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 210,000.

title: Children's Pajamas Recalled by Ishtex Textile Products Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear posing a risk of burn injury to children. The garments were advertised and sold as children's sleepwear. Units: About 6,000.

title: Exhaust Fans Sold at Lowe's Stores Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Made by Delta Electronics Dongguan
summary: The fan's heater blades can fail to rotate properly, causing the fan to overheat and posing a fire hazard. Units: About 68,000.

title: IKEA Recalls Track Lighting System Due to Electric Shock Hazard
summary: The ground connection in the track is defective, posing an electric shock hazard. Units: About 5,000 in the United States (and about 97,000 worldwide).

title: PajamaGram Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 12,000.

title: Watkins Manufacturing and Therm Products Recall Spas Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A loose internal electrical connection of the spa heaters can overheat and ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,600.

title: Alltrade Tools Recalls Kawasaki Cordless Drill Due to Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Costco
summary: The trigger switches can short and generate excessive heat posing a burn hazard. Units: About 45,000.

title: Big Cat Human Powered Vehicles Recalls Bicycle Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The bicycle frame can crack, which can cause the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 170 units.

title: Samuel Lawrence Furniture Recalls Sleigh Beds Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The hardware holding the headboard and footboard can loosen or detach, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 18,400 in the United States and 1,250 in Canada..

title: Servpro Recalls Notus Air Movers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The air mover/blower's internal electrical capacitor can fail and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 24,000.

title: Bluestem Brands and Tone World International Recall Recliner Chair Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standards
summary: The surface paint on the legs of the recliner contains excessive levels of lead which is prohibited under federal law. Units: About 405.

title: Currie Technologies Recalls Adult Tricycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The rear axle can break causing a rear wheel to detach, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 2,100.

title: Flushmate Recalls Flushmate® III Pressure-Assisted Flushing System Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards
summary: The system can burst at or near the vessel weld seam releasing stored pressure. This pressure can lift the tank lid and shatter the tank, posing impact or laceration hazards to consumers and property damage. Units: About 2,330,600 in the U.S. and 9,400 in Canada.

title: Big Lots Recalls Portable Ceramic Space Heaters Due to Fire, Electric Shock Hazard
summary: The heaters can overheat and melt, posing a fire or electric shock hazard. Units: About 70,500.

title: Frigidaire Gas Range Recalled Due to Fire Hazard, Sold Exclusively at Lowe's Stores
summary: There can be a delayed ignition on the bake/broil features of the oven, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 185.

title: Air Movers Recalled by EDIC Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The air mover/blower's internal electrical capacitor can fail and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 53,000.

title: Bel Air Lighting Recalls Outdoor Wall Mount Lanterns Due to Fire, Burn and Shock Hazards
summary: An electrical short circuit can occur in the lanterns' internal wiring, posing a risk of fire, burn and electric shock to consumers. Units: About 99,700.

title: Ceiling Mounted Light Fixtures Recalled by Thomas Lighting Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The fixture's socket wire insulation can degrade, leading to charged wires becoming exposed, causing electricity to pass to the metal canopy of the fixture. This poses a fire and electric shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 83,750.
